material.acceptance_criteria: under a sustained overrun the overrun counter stops increasing within a bounded number of ticks after shedding starts; a generous-budget run that posts orders logs zero tick-shed lines; gate reports 0 failed on each OS.
material.description: Shedding at rust/crates/server/src/room.rs (cap on the order drain while the streak is at or above SHED_AFTER_OVERRUNS) defers queued orders but does not lower sim.tick() cost, so the overrun count keeps rising under sustained load. Add a real cost reduction under overrun (for example skip a named set of non-essential per-tick sim systems or mod ticks while shedding, restored on recovery) and strengthen the generous-budget CI check so it posts orders and asserts zero tick-shed lines under a loose budget.
material.resolution: Rescoped by the orchestrator to the loose-budget half: a generous budget with orders posted drains every order and logs zero tick-shed lines. Sim tick cost is the floor and cannot be skipped without changing game state, so the tight-budget overrun counter is a diagnostic, not a target. Recorded: under a 1 us budget overrun still fires every tick; shedding defers queued orders only.
material.subject: Reduce tick cost under sustained overrun, not only defer orders
material.witness: ci-status run 38899575815 for e53e095a90c11a10db7dc1c884f6974ea5e8733e; ci.yml drain-check step; server lib.rs route 196 and resources 223
